item.title: Guwahati Joins Nationwide Bank Strike on January 27 Over Five-Day Work Week Demand
item.description: GUWAHATI: A nationwide bank strike called by the United Forum of Bank Unions (UFBU) affected banking services in Guwahati on January 27, as bank employees protested to press for the introduction of a five-day work week in the banking sector. item.title: Winter Storm Across the US Causes Massive Outages; At Least 30 Fatalities Reported
item.description: GUWAHATI: A major winter storm that swept across a wide stretch of the United States has left at least 30 people dead, according to reports, and caused widespread travel disruption and power outages. The storm brought heavy snow, freezing temperatures and dangerous ice across regions from the South to the Northeast, with forecasters warning that the cold could persist into early February.
